name: Otter Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a Michigan DNR inland lake map (survey year not recorded in the source) (contours digitized by the agency from its survey). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 40.8 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (100% of water cells at >=0.4). No fish-community or water-clarity record is wired for Michigan in v1 - thermal regime, Secchi and fish community use documented fallbacks.
